question: A 5-man group made up of one tank, one healer, and three DPS is doing a dungeon that was just released in World of Warcraft. Two are plate wearers and two are cloth wearers. At the final boss, both the tank and the healer are casting holy spells. Ice and fire are being used, each one by a different DPS. A bear from the group is attacking the boss. Metamorphosis is cast. The Kilt of the Forgotten One drops as loot, but no one can use it. If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?
ground_truth: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Searched for "World of Warcraft Metamorphosis class" and reviewed summaries: In WoW, Metamorphosis is historically a Warlock (Demonology) ability (notably in Wrath-era and beyond). Demon Hunters also use Metamorphosis, but that class was introduced in a later expansion (Legion) and is not relevant to early/Wrath-era dungeon contexts. Therefore, the Metamorphosis clue points to a Warlock in this group.

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Resetting. Starting fresh without prior steps.

Given a 5-man group: tank, healer, three DPS. Two plate wearers, two cloth wearers. Tank and healer casting holy spells strongly suggests Paladin (tank) and Priest (healer). For DPS:
- Fire can be covered by Warlock (Destruction).
- A bear attacking the boss is consistent with a Hunter pet (bear), not necessarily a Druid.
- Ice usage can be attributed to Hunter via frost-based traps and shots in combat.
Armor distribution then fits: Paladin and Warrior as the two plate wearers; Priest and Warlock as the two cloth wearers; Hunter is mail. The Kilt of the Forgotten One being leather explains why no one can equip it.
Thus the five unique classes are Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock, Warrior. In alphabetical order: Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock, Warrior.
